notes.title: V1.0.1
notes.content:
Added turkish and ukrainian languages.
 Skins popup description.
 Fixed item shop issue in spanish and russian language.
 Moved capybara to center and item shop to left. Making the item shop smaller.
 Skins drop time now is saved between gameplays (but forcing minimum of 25 minutes).
 Preparing Prestige System
 Reduced default value of music sound to 25% instead of 50%
 Fixed issue with users not receiving their drops. This should not happen again.
 Have you seen my goatybara?

notes.title: Capybara is Coming! Official Release on August 30, 2024
notes.content:
Attention all gamers! 🎮

We are thrilled to announce that our new game, Capybara, will be available on August 30, 2024. Get ready for a clicker adventure like no other!

This week, we've added exciting new features to enhance your gaming experience:


 Steam Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide and prove who is the best!
 Idle System: Now you can earn points automatically when you reopen the game after being away. Don't miss a single moment!
 5 New Items: Explore and discover the new items we've added to help you on your journey to the top.

Mark your calendar and join us in this fun and addictive adventure with Capybara. See you on August 30!
